course.title: Computer Science
course.description: Introduction to programming and computer science

assignments.title: Level 0: Python Basics
assignments.description: Variables, data types, conditionals, and loops

assignments.title: Level 2: Python Classes
assignments.description: Defining and using classes in Python

assignments.title: Level 3: Data Analysis
assignments.description: Basics of data analysis: loading, exploring, and visualizing data in Python.

assignments.title: Level 4: Testing with Pytest
assignments.description: Learn unit testing with pytest by covering normal behavior, edge cases, and invalid inputs.

assignments.title: Level 5: Building REST APIs with FastAPI
assignments.description: Learn to build modern REST APIs with FastAPI framework, including CRUD operations and data validation

assignments.title: Level 6: Agentic Timer App
assignments.description: Co-engineer a small software project using custom prompts or agents across requirements, architecture, implementation, and validation.
